about_the_game:
Korrin Horne is a 2D dystopian action-platformer set in a decaying world of steel, faith, and forgotten humanity.

You play as Korrin Horne, a weary enforcer fighting to preserve what little remains of mankind in a towering megacity, built above the ruins of the old world.

Explore multi-layered districts — from the decaying slums below to the irradiated towers that pierce the clouds. Each level hides its own dangers, mysteries, and echoes of a civilization long dead.

  • Fight your way through hordes of rogue automatons, cultists, and mechanical monstrosities.

  • Unravel the past and face the consequences of humanity’s sins in a world where faith and technology collide.

With its grim atmosphere, handcrafted pixel environments, and fast-paced combat, Korrin Horne offers a brutal yet emotional journey through the last bastions of a dying age.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5gb MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Play as Korrin Horne — an enforcer surviving in the ruins of collapsing megacities. Battle rogue machines, upgrade your gear, and uncover the dark truths buried beneath layers of steel and ash.
